{
  "dataset_name": "bank_marketing",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "duration_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized call duration using training mean and std, capturing how far a call duration deviates from the average in standard deviation units",
      "value_range": [-0.98, 14.75],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes duration to unit scale for fair distance computation in KNN, preventing high-variance features from dominating",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(duration - 259.8566) / 266.7895"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized age using training mean and std for scale-consistent distance computation",
      "value_range": [-2.22, 5.57],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ensures age contributes proportionally to KNN distance metrics alongside other normalized features",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 40.1456) / 10.4039"
    },
    {
      "name": "economic_stress_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite economic stress score combining employment variation rate and euribor3m rate, both z-score normalized and summed",
      "value_range": [-3.5, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures macroeconomic environment as a single normalized dimension, improving neighborhood geometry for economically similar records",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((emp.var.rate - 0.0814) / 1.5699) + ((euribor3m - 3.6179) / 1.7357)"
    },
    {
      "name": "campaign_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed and z-score normalized number of campaign contacts, reducing skew from outliers with many contacts",
      "value_range": [-1.5, 4.5],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses heavy right tail of campaign counts for better distance geometry, preventing outlier contacts from distorting neighborhoods",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(campaign) - np.log1p(2.5617)) / (np.log1p(2.5617 + 2.7709) - np.log1p(2.5617 - 2.7709 + 2.7709))"
    },
    {
      "name": "pdays_contact_recency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Recency indicator derived from pdays: 0 when never contacted before (pdays=999), otherwise normalized days since last contact",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Distinguishes never-contacted prospects from previously contacted ones, creating meaningful cluster separation in KNN space",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(pdays >= 999, 0.0, 1.0 - (pdays / 999.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "consumer_sentiment_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized consumer confidence index shifted to positive range for distance computation",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a clean 0-1 scaled sentiment dimension for KNN, improving neighborhood quality for economically similar customers",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(cons.conf.idx - (-50.8)) / ((-26.9) - (-50.8))"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_vulnerability_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite score combining housing loan and personal loan indicators to measure financial obligation burden",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups customers by financial obligation profile, creating meaningful clusters for KNN neighborhood identification",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(housing > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(loan > 0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(default > 0, 2.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "engagement_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of call duration to number of campaign contacts, measuring average engagement per contact attempt",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4199.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures quality of engagement per contact, helping KNN find neighbors with similar engagement patterns rather than just similar raw counts",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "duration / np.maximum(campaign, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "prior_campaign_success_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator combining previous contacts and successful prior outcome (poutcome=1 indicates success)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a strong cluster separator between customers with successful prior campaign history vs others, improving KNN neighborhood purity",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((previous > 0) & (poutcome == 1), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_education_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized product of z-scored age and education level, capturing life-stage and education combinations",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures demographic profile interactions that define meaningful customer segments for KNN neighborhood geometry",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((age - 40.1456) / 10.4039) * ((education - 3.7506) / 2.1317)"
    },
    {
      "name": "macroeconomic_environment_cluster",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of the macroeconomic environment quality based on employment rate, euribor, and consumer price index combinations. Score 0=very unfavorable (high rates, low employment), 1=unfavorable, 2=neutral, 3=favorable, 4=very favorable economic conditions for customer receptivity",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups records into macroeconomic regime clusters, enabling KNN to find neighbors experiencing similar economic conditions which strongly influences customer behavior",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "customer_profile_receptivity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score assessing how receptive a customer profile appears based on job stability, education level, marital status, and absence of financial stress indicators. Scale 0=very low receptivity profile, 1=low, 2=moderate, 3=high, 4=very high receptivity profile",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic customer profile dimension that helps KNN identify neighbors with similar demographic and financial receptivity characteristics",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
